backend/main.mo: Defines student, roll call, and user profile types and implements authorization-gated CRUD operations for students and roll calls using multiple Map stores.
backend/migration.mo: Provides migration logic converting old student and roll call formats to new structures and builds class/section mappings while updating ID counters.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries mapping features to frontend files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten short summaries for each frontend file describing its purpose and recent updates.
frontend/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles and extensive OKLCH color tokens for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell that loads the React app entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack router with routes for all main pages and wraps them in the AttendanceSessionProvider and AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/AddStudentDialog: Modal dialog for adding a student with validation, auth gating, and backend submission tied to selected class/section.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper showing login/profile state, rendering routed content, and displaying a footer and profile setup dialog.
frontend/src/components/EditStudentDialo: Dialog component for editing a student's details with validation, auth checks, and update mutation.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with status handling and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Dialog prompting the user to enter and save a name to set up their profile.
frontend/src/components/StudentAttendanc: UI row for marking a student's attendance and optionally triggering a WhatsApp action.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppPreviewD: Dialog previewing a WhatsApp message before sending, supporting single and bulk modes.
frontend/src/constants/school.ts: Defines class and section lists and provides a helper to format class display names.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the current identity and invalidates dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Auth hook determining authentication, user role, admin status, and generating authorization error messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, identity state, and related status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useRollCall.ts: Provides React Query hooks to load and save roll‑call attendance using temporary localStorage until backend methods exist.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudents.ts: Defines hooks for fetching, adding, updating, and deleting students via the backend actor with React Query caching.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Implements hooks to retrieve and update the current user's profile through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind CSS layers and defines light/dark theme CSS variables and base styles.
frontend/src/lib/attendanceRepo.ts: Legacy localStorage‑based attendance getter and saver, now superseded by useRollCall hooks.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Utility functions for formatting dates, converting to display formats, and extracting weekday names.
frontend/src/lib/localStore.ts: Small helpers to safely get and save JSON data in localStorage.
frontend/src/lib/studentsRepo.ts: Deprecated localStorage student storage with functions to list, add, and delete students.
frontend/src/lib/summary.ts: Computes summary counts of present and absent students from an attendance record.
frontend/src/lib/types.ts: Defines basic Student, AttendanceStatus, and AttendanceRecord TypeScript types.
frontend/src/lib/validation.ts: Validates student form fields and returns error messages for missing inputs.
frontend/src/lib/whatsapp.ts: Builds WhatsApp message payloads and URLs for single or bulk recipients with phone normalization.
frontend/src/lib/whatsappTemplate.ts: Manages WhatsApp templates with placeholder rendering, localStorage persistence, and message generation.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Entry point that initializes React, wraps App with Internet Identity and React Query providers.
frontend/src/pages/AttendancePage.tsx: Displays and saves daily attendance for a selected class/section, loads students and existing roll call, and supports WhatsApp messaging per student.
frontend/src/pages/ClassSelectionPage.ts: Allows selecting class and section and stores the choice in session state before navigating to the student list.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with an entry button that navigates to class selection to start attendance.
frontend/src/pages/StudentListPage.tsx: Shows students for the chosen class/section with options to add, edit, delete, and send bulk WhatsApp messages.
frontend/src/pages/SummaryPage.tsx: Displays attendance totals for the selected date and class/section using saved roll‑call data.
Provides an editor for customizing WhatsApp message templates with placeholders and live preview.
frontend/src/state/attendanceSession.tsx: Context provider storing selected class, section, and date with helpers to update session state.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters (including hash routes), storing/retrieving them in sessionStorage, and persisting or clearing them as needed.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s state, known issues with missing students, and pending feature requests related to attendance exports and data persistence.
